programmes.d: A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.
An elderly couple visit the New Life Corporation, hoping to transport their personalities into youthful artificial bodies.

At a prominent club in Washington, D.C., a socialite argues about whether it would be possible to change history by traveling back in time. When he leaves the club he finds himself in 1865, on the night that President Lincoln will be shot.
A ventriloquist's dummy goads him into committing burglaries.
Jared Garrity arrives in the Old West town of Happiness, Arizona, proclaiming he can revive the dead.
Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.
Jess-Belle enlists the aid of a local witch who casts a spell that makes Billy-Ben fall in love with her.
In 1942, a German wonders why he's on the deck of a British steamship, with no memory of how he got there, and an overwhelming sense of impending doom.
A man travels back in time to try to prevent some of history's catastrophes.
A vagrant steps into a murdered gangster's expensive shoes and is taken over by the dead man's ghost, who vows to remain on Earth to seek revenge against his killer.
When three dum-dum crooks get ahold of a camera that takes pictures of the future, they set out to make a quick fortune with their new toy.
A dejected jockey wants to be tall.
Cavender, an angel trying to win his wings, tries to help down-on-her-luck Agnes, who has just been fired.
Businessman Arthur Curtis discovers that life as he knows it doesn't really exist.
A former Nazi SS Captain returns to the ruins of a concentration camp to reminisce and is met by one of his victims.
A cheating husband sees his secret revealed and its horrible consequences on his just-repaired TV set.
A nostalgic actor revisits his late wife and friends at their old haunt, only to find that he is now out of place there.
Confederacy scout Sgt. Joseph Paradine finds a town full of Union soldiers, and an old man who claims he used witchcraft to paralyze them.
Annoyed by a club member's constant chatter, a man bets him he cannot remain silent for a year, living in a glass enclosure in the club basement.
A singer's song becomes tragically real.
Passing through the sound barrier a commercial airliner inadvertently travels back in time.

An elderly private school teacher wonders if his life has meant anything as he contemplates suicide on Christmas Eve and is reminded by former students that he has, indeed, had an impact on their lives.
An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

Awakened by the cries of their daughter Bettina, Chris and Ruth Miller enter her room to find that she has vanished - even though they still hear her crying for help. Chris' physicist friend Bill thinks she moved into another dimension.
Woodrow, a janitor living in the year 1890, accidentally activates a time traveling helmet which transports him to 1962 - then promptly breaks down.
Bartlett Finchley's paranoia about the machines around proves true.
A mysterious guardian helps a tiny community survive after the Bomb destroys much of the Earth.
Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...
